Our Company

Established in December 2016, AVIAVENTURA is one of the leading and notable GSSAs in Indonesia. With a team of experienced professionals and strong industry connections, we are committed to enhancing our partners' market presence and delivering exceptional service. Our goal is to be the preferred partner in the aviation and tourism sectors, driving growth and success for all our stakeholders.

Be Our Partner

Since 2016, AVIAVENTURA has proudly served as a trusted GSA in Indonesia, managing operations for over eight airlines. Our commitment to personalized service and market expertise ensures that partnering with us means your airline will achieve sustained success in the Indonesian market.
